newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy grows 4.7 pct in Jan vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy grows 4.7 pct in Jan vs year ago.

text.p: Chile's economic activity, as measured by the government's Imacec index, expanded 4.7 percent in January compared with the same month a year ago, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
The index showed monthly growth in January slowing sharply from the 8.1 percent increase recorded in December and 9.8 percent rise in January 1996.
January's expansion was the lowest monthly growth figure for over two years.
